testi.descrizione: Copies the selected folders, including subfolders. A file already in the backup is replaced when the size differs or the source is newer. If a copy is interrupted, the previous file stays intact.
testi.about_proprieta: This program is the property of AndyD.
testi.about_donazione: If you find it useful, you can support the project with a donation on Ko-fi.
testi.rispecchia: Mirror: move files missing from the source into the trash folder
testi.esclusioni_aiuto: Names separated by commas. An asterisk stands for any part of the name.
testi.stato_attesa: Waiting. Add a folder and start the copy.
